1.he: ירושלמי חגיגה פ"א ה"א ומגילה פ"ד ה"א
1.note: Weiss writes "halakhah 1" for both places. In the usual numbering of the Yerushalmi the saying is at Ḥagigah 1:8 and Megillah 4:1; the English gives those.

2.note: The print has Yosifon, the Hebrew name used in Weiss's time for Josephus as well as for the medieval Sefer Yosippon. The statement that the Sadducees rejected the tradition of the elders is from Josephus, Antiquities 13.297, so the English gives Josephus.

3.note: The year is printed as 1889 in this scan, but the volume appeared in 1871, and Graetz's commentary on Ecclesiastes, which dates the book to the time of Herod, appeared in 1871. The printed figure is probably a misprint (for 1869?). The English keeps the printed year.

4.note: The figures of these two references are printed left to right inside the Hebrew line and are partly blurred in the scan; the reading 42:22 and 64:9–10 is the most likely one.
